text:
paige: CSM raised billing dispute from CloudShift on INV-2026-66022. They want a refund (not credit) for platform fee during a 45-day pilot that moved 70% capacity to a partner-managed Dedicated environment. Renewal looming.
omar: paste invoice lines?
paige: invoice excerpt:
``
INV-2026-66022
Period: 2026-10-01 to 2027-09-30
Private Deployment Platform Fee (annual) - $90,000
Support: Premium (annual) - $22,000
Pilot: 45-day partner-managed Dedicated pilot 2026-11-01 to 2026-12-15 - 70% capacity (OPS-12012)
Overage: committed GPU true-up - 500 hrs @ $16/hr = $8,000
```
viv: contract review: platform fee is annual and non-refundable except as stated in amendment. any amendment or signed SOW?
paige: customer attached partner SOW that references "pilot concession" but it's ambiguous: partner SOW is not the same as our contract. Sales thread shows AE wrote "we'll refund pilot period if partner runs it" but no legal sign-off.
omar: ops confirms OPS-12012 executed. partner-managed pilot removed capacity from our Private cluster. ops didn't submit a billing change request.
accounts-bot: automated: refund/credit policy: refunds require Exec approval; credits can be issued by Revenue Ops if documented.
viv: finance take: support proration is allowed (per clause 6.1) and we can credit that now. platform fee refund request > $5k (estimate refund = 90,000 * 0.7 * 45/365 = $7,716.44) so needs Head of Revenue + legal approval; customer specifically requested cash refund instead of account credit.
paige: customer insists refund necessary due to partner contractual terms. they threatened to pause renewal if we don't refund. asking for outcome by EOD 2026-12-20.
omar: propose steps: 1) post support proration credit immediately (calc below), 2) create provisional refund request for platform amount and escalate to legal + Head of Revenue, 3) create GPU-hour audit to validate test runs exclusion, 4) hold invoice for 30 days to avoid collections while we escalate.
viv: support proration calc: Premium - Standard = 22k - 8k = 14k diff. Premium effective 2026-11-05, so Standard period 10/1-11/4 = 35 days -> credit = 14,000 * 35/365 = $1,341.10. postable now.
accounts-bot: automated: provisional credit memo CM-2026-2000 created for support proration $1,341.10. Reference INV-2026-66022. Status: pending revenue-ops approval.
paige: customer asked for immediate refund for platform pilot portion ($7,716.44). can we issue a provisional payment hold and escalate?
viv: we can mark a payment hold and escalate but payments/refunds require treasury sign-off. legal: please review partner SOW and AE notes; if AE committed refund in writing we might have contractual basis.
legal: send me the partner SOW + sales thread + CSM notes. if written AE commitment exists we can consider a one-time refund with Exec signoff. otherwise recommend account credit only.
omar: ops to run GPU usage audit for pilot window to confirm how many hours were legitimate production vs test. if test hours found, adjust overage.
collections: we can set a 30-day hold for strategic accounts. I'll apply hold until 2027-01-15 and notify AR.
paige: customer asked for cash refund to be processed within 10 business days if approved. they want written timeline by EOD.
viv: action items: (1) revenue-ops post CM-2026-2000 (@viv), (2) legal review partner SOW + sales notes and advise on refundability (@legal), (3) ops: run GPU audit for OPS-12012 (@omar), (4) collections: apply 30-day hold until 2027-01-15 (@collections), (5) treasury: standby for refund processing if approved.
paige: I'll collate docs and ping legal/sales. customer fragile on renewal; please prioritize. :pray:
